Tape the various areas illustrated in the diagram using masking tape.

Carry out a road test letting the vehicle gradually reach the speed at which the noise appears: if the noise persists, check for the presence of sealant between the wing and the pillar in the lower area.

Remove the masking tape from zone A and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, check the condition of the door housing seal in that area and that it adheres correctly to the bodyshell (see Op. 7005A34 ); also check the condition of the bonnet hinge buffer.

Remove the masking tape from zone B and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, check the condition of the door housing seal in that arae and that it adheres correctly to the bodyshell (see Op. 7005A34 ).

Also adjust the door hinges (see Op. 7005A14 ). Remove shims from the upper hinge or add shims to the lower one so that the door adheres better to the seal.

Remove the masking tape from zone C and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, adjust the door hinges (see Op. 7005A14 ). Remove or add shims from/to the two hinges, so that the door adheres better to the seal.

Remove the masking tape from zone D and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, check the condition of the glass scraper (see Op. 7005D26 ).

Remove the masking tape from the rear view mirror (zone E) and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, check the condition of the seal between the mirror and the door and the mirror itself (see Op. 7005R30 ).
